premises.text: Wired charging and charging pads fail as solutions because pads block phone use, look ugly, and charge only one device per pad section
premises.evidence_span: You can't use your phone while it's charging. It's kind of ugly. And worst of all, each section of pad can only charge one device at a time

premises.text: Pi uses a patented magnetic-field-bending platform to safely charge multiple devices at any angle in a contactless, FCC-compliant way, including legacy devices via cases
premises.evidence_span: our patented platform can power multiple devices at any angle

premises.text: Direct-to-consumer sales of Pi units are paired with opening the platform to consumer-electronics OEMs
premises.evidence_span: First, we will sell Pi directly to consumers

value.text: Users charge phones and tablets truly wirelessly without pads, tangles, or single-device limits

causal_links.evidence_span: five devices now charging simultaneously at different angles from just one pie
opening the Pi platform for use by existing consumer electronics OEMs

notes: Wire/pad pain facets folded as one problem set. Safety vs microwave/ultrasound/laser alternatives and Qi/legacy-case details folded into magnetic Pi mechanism (cascade + IP). DTC and OEM channels kept in one commercial module as speaker presents two parts of one business model. Reservation/press traction and investor names excluded.
